tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a fresh full-body neutral visual-novel sprite of Aether from Genshin Impact. Image 1 is the official portrait, guiding identity, costume and polished anime illustration style; image 2 is the user-provided in-game model, guiding accurate face, eyes, skin tone, hair, outfit, accessories and colors. Faithfully preserve these details, translating the model into the illustration style of the official portrait. Petite Medium Male proportions. Stand in a relaxed three-quarter angle with a gentle weight shift, his right hand resting naturally on his hip and his left arm lowered, hand relaxed at his side. For his face closely follow the model: a coherent pair of golden amber anime eyes of matching shape and scale, each with an intact iris and one normal small dark pupil within it. Both eyes look in the same direction, with clean eyelids, natural eye corners, and restrained highlights. Calm attentive resting face with relaxed eyebrows and one closed straight mouth, neither smiling nor frowning. Hair and clothing hang naturally. Each hand has a palm, four fingers and a separate opposable thumb with natural articulation, without forcing hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet comfortably separated. No weapon. Full silhouette including hair, accessories, hands and shoes visible with approximately 2–4% top and bottom padding. Polished anime game artwork on a genuinely transparent background. No scenery, UI, labels, watermark, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
